rules.topic: Bees work on a 550-tick cycle (27.5 seconds): production rolls, lifespan aging and pollination all advance per work cycle, and a bee's lifespan allele counts in cycles - so breeding math is done in 27.5-second units, not ticks or minutes

Bee traits (species, speed, lifespan, fertility, climate tolerances, products and specialties) are genome alleles defined as data in the jar; inheritance mixes both parents' active and inactive alleles, and drones pass both allele sets by default (the haploid-drone variant rule exists as a config but defaults OFF) - quote any species' numbers from the layer-2 genome data, not from code constants

value.model: allele genome data; haploid drones off by default

rules.topic: Apiary frames modify the housing through per-frame bee modifiers (production, lifespan, mutation, territory effects are properties of each frame item); the alveary adds its own modifier blocks on top - frame effect numbers are item data

Multiblock farm working area: allowedExtent = max(layout width/depth) x multiblock_farm_size + 1, and the farm area is (7 + 2 x allowedExtent) blocks square and 13 blocks tall; with the default size config of 2 (ForestryConfig.java line 122) and a typical 3-block layout, allowedExtent is 7 and the farm works a 21 x 21 area

Researching a mutation in the escritoire raises that mutation's chance for the researcher's own hives, but the boost is capped at 5 percent by default config - mutation hunting stays mostly a numbers game of princess/drone throughput
